nodes.display_name: High school - A happy society with the right technology
nodes.long_description:
1.Cut open a plastic bottle and line the inside with gauze, cotton balls, activated charcoal, charcoal, sand, or pebbles to make a 
water purifier
2.Use the make-money pump to collect water and purify it with the water purifier
3.Add bleach to the purified water to make a plastic bottle light bulb
nodes.short_description:
Titration Technology Stories
Experiment on making titration technology water purifier and plastic bottle light bulb using MakeMoney Pump
